tasks.name_en: Hang the cool frying pan by its handle hole on the marked pot-rack hook, cooking face toward the wall
tasks.name_ja: 冷めたフライパンを持ち手の穴で所定の鍋掛けフックに掛け、調理面を壁側に向ける
instruction_variants: Hang the small frying pan on the marked pot-rack hook through the hole in its handle, with the cooking side facing the wall.
Put the 8-inch pan up on the tagged hook by its handle hole so the inside of the pan faces the wall.
小さいフライパンを持ち手の穴で印の付いた鍋掛けフックに掛け、調理面を壁側に向けてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the pan hangs from the marked hook with its cooking face toward the wall. Labelled atomic: one object and one placement change in one motion; the facing direction is a constraint on that single placement, not a second stage. The GSO scan is rigid and does not confirm the handle hole; hanging and swing behaviour belong to the physical pan.

tasks.name_en: Hang the clean porcelain mug by its handle on the marked under-cabinet cup hook
tasks.name_ja: 洗った磁器マグを持ち手で吊り戸棚下の所定のカップフックに掛ける
instruction_variants: Hang the white mug on the marked cup hook under the cabinet by its handle.
Take the clean bead mug from the drainer and hook its handle onto the tagged cup hook.
白いマグを持ち手で吊り戸棚の下にある印の付いたカップフックに掛けてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the mug hangs from the marked cup hook by its handle, handle-up toward the cabinet underside. Labelled atomic: one object and one placement change. Distinct from task_ycb_round1_mug (handover) and task_reference_robocasa_coffee_setup_mug (counter placement): the goal here is hook storage. The GSO scan does not measure the handle gap, so hook fit must be checked on the physical mug.

tasks.name_en: Screw the lid of the instant coffee jar fully closed
tasks.name_ja: インスタントコーヒー瓶のふたを最後まで締める
instruction_variants: Tighten the lid on the instant coffee jar until it stops turning.
The coffee jar's lid is only resting on top; screw it closed.
インスタントコーヒーの瓶のふたが回らなくなるまで締めてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the jar is closed with its lid fully seated. Labelled atomic: one object and one goal predicate change (loose to closed). The lid starts resting on the threads so the task does not include finding or placing the lid. Reuses template_ycb_close_container. The GSO scan fuses jar and lid into one rigid mesh, so thread engagement and torque need the physical jar.

tasks.name_en: Lay the closed can opener in its marked drawer-organizer slot with the cutting wheel toward the back
tasks.name_ja: 閉じた缶切りを引き出し整理トレーの所定の枠に、刃のホイールを奥に向けて置く
instruction_variants: Put the can opener in its slot in the utensil drawer, closed, with the cutting wheel toward the back.
Store the closed can opener flat in the marked organizer compartment, wheel end away from you.
缶切りを閉じたまま、刃のホイールを奥に向けて引き出しの所定の枠に入れてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the closed can opener lies in the marked organizer slot with its cutting wheel toward the back. Labelled atomic: one object and one placement change; wheel direction and closed handles are constraints kept during that placement. The drawer starts open, so no articulated drawer motion is in scope. The GSO scan is rigid; hinged handles and the crank do not move in the mesh.

tasks.name_en: Stack four square dinner plates with corners aligned and a felt protector between each on the cabinet shelf
tasks.name_ja: 角皿4枚を角をそろえ、間にフェルトの保護シートを挟んで食器棚の棚に重ねる
instruction_variants: Stack the four square plates on the cabinet shelf with a felt pad between each pair and the corners lined up.
Put the dry square dinner plates away in one aligned stack, a protector between every plate.
4枚の角皿を、1枚ごとにフェルトの保護シートを挟み、角をそろえて食器棚に重ねてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: several objects (the scanned plate, three matching plates, three protectors) and five goal predicates in one sitting at one destination, with no reset between stages. The GSO model is one plate and is bound explicitly as the bottom plate of the stack (stacked_on the shelf); the three matching plates above it are a planning resource. The goal is chip-free storage, distinct from existing plate tasks that set, clear, inspect, or rack a single plate.

tasks.name_en: Portion three measured dry surrogates into ramekins lined up on the porcelain tray
tasks.name_ja: 計量した3種類の乾いた代替材料をラメキンに分け、磁器トレーの上に一列に並べる
instruction_variants: Set out three ramekins in a row on the porcelain tray and pour one measured cup into each, rice, lentils, then sugar from left to right.
Prep the mise en place: each ramekin on the tray gets one of the three pre-measured dry ingredients.
磁器トレーにラメキンを3つ一列に並べ、計量済みの材料を左から米、レンズ豆、砂糖の順に1つずつ入れてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: six items (three ramekins, three portions) on one tray in one sitting, with seven goal predicates and no reset between stages. Connects to round 1 by using the round-1 GSO porcelain tray (gso_object_porcelain_tray) as the tray. The GSO ramekin model is one ramekin; the other two are matching physical ramekins declared as planning resources. Dry, non-perishable surrogates stand in for recipe ingredients; tray dimensions have not been checked against three ramekins. in_a_row lists the ramekins left to right as seen from the counter front: the scanned ramekin with rice on the left, ramekin b with lentils in the middle, ramekin c with sugar on the right. Tray fit stays an unverified condition; the tray interior is measured once and the same recorded value is meant to serve the round-1 tray-carry task (task_gso_r1_tray_carry_mugs_sugar_bowl).

tasks.name_en: Seat the cover on the butter dish and put it in the refrigerator door dairy compartment with the door closed
tasks.name_ja: バターディッシュにふたをかぶせ、冷蔵庫ドアの乳製品ポケットに入れてドアを閉める
instruction_variants: Put the cover on the butter dish, set it in the dairy pocket on the fridge door, and close the door.
Cover the butter and put it back in the refrigerator door compartment, then shut the fridge.
バターディッシュにふたをして冷蔵庫ドアの乳製品ポケットに入れ、ドアを閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: three goal predicates (cover seated, dish in compartment, door closed) and two moved parts in one sitting. The refrigerator door starts open and ends closed, so one articulated closure is in scope. The GSO scan is a single rigid mesh of base and cover; the separable cover must come from the physical dish. A wrapped butter stick or a butter-shaped surrogate is used.

tasks.name_en: Empty, rinse, and refill the ceramic pet water bowl to its line and set it back on a dry feeding mat
tasks.name_ja: 陶器製のペット用水入れを空にしてすすぎ、線まで水を入れて乾いた給餌マットの上に戻す
instruction_variants: Refresh the pet's water: empty the bowl in the sink, rinse it, fill it to the line, and set it back on the mat after drying the mat.
Take the water bowl off the feeding mat, dump and rinse it, refill to the marker, wipe the mat dry, and put the bowl back.
ペットの水入れをシンクで空にしてすすぎ、線まで水を入れ、マットを拭いてから元の位置に戻してください。
tasks.notes: Workflow with checkpointed stages at two destinations (sink and feeding area): empty and rinse at the sink, fill to the line with a checkpoint, dry the mat, and return the bowl. The feeding area is modelled inside scene_home_kitchen rather than as a new scene. No pet is present during collection. The GSO scan is rigid and carries no water or fill-line representation; the fill line is a marker applied to the physical bowl. Emptying is not a separate goal predicate: rinsed and filled_to imply the old water was poured out. The mat counts as dry when no droplets are visible and a dry paper towel pressed on it for 3 s shows no wet mark.

tasks.name_en: Set the slide sandal sole-down on the bath mat with its opening facing the shower door
tasks.name_ja: スライドサンダルを底を下にしてバスマットに置き、履き口をシャワーの扉に向ける
instruction_variants: Put the slide on the bath mat, sole down, with the open toe end pointing at the shower door.
Move the sandal from the corner onto the mat so you could step straight into it coming out of the shower.
スライドサンダルを底を下にしてバスマットに置き、履き口をシャワーの扉に向けてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the slide rests sole-down on the bath mat, opening toward the shower door. Labelled atomic: one object and one placement with a heading, in one motion; stable is the resting consequence of that placement, not a second goal. Uses the new template_gso_transport_orient_item, which copies the roles, preconditions, and goals of template_ycb_transport_orient_object; the YCB template is not reused because its compatible_scenes cover only YCB scenes (playroom, workshop, storage shelf) and it lives in another lane's active seed, whereas this template declares the bathroom and entryway. Merging the two is left to a later consolidation. The scan is rigid; sole flex and wetness are not represented.

tasks.name_en: Hang the hand towel through the towel ring with both ends level
tasks.name_ja: ハンドタオルを両端の高さをそろえてタオルリングに掛ける
instruction_variants: Hang the blue hand towel through the ring by the sink so both ends hang at the same height.
Put the folded hand towel up on the towel ring, evened out on both sides.
青いハンドタオルを洗面台横のタオルリングに通し、両端の高さをそろえて掛けてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the towel hangs through the ring with level ends. Labelled atomic: one object and one hanging change; level ends are the acceptance tolerance of that hang, not a separate stage. The GSO scan is a rigid folded towel, so draping and end length belong to the real towel.

tasks.name_en: Lay the dish drying mat flat beside the sink parallel to the counter edge
tasks.name_ja: 食器用水切りマットをシンクの横に、カウンターの縁と平行に平らに敷く
instruction_variants: Unroll the red drying mat next to the sink and lay it flat with its long side along the counter edge.
Put the drying mat down by the sink, flat, no corners folded, lined up with the front of the counter.
赤い水切りマットをシンクの横に広げ、角を折らずに長辺をカウンターの縁と平行にして敷いてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the mat lies flat in the sink-side zone with its long edge parallel to the counter front. Labelled atomic: the mat starts flat on the counter away from the zone, so the task is one relocation into the zone with a parallel pose qualifier; flatness is kept, not created. Rolling was removed from the start state after review so that no shape change is stacked on the placement. Not a skill-only task because the end state is a specific laid-out configuration. The scan is rigid and cannot represent the limp drape or corner curl.

tasks.name_en: Stand the closed conditioner bottle in the vanity organizer compartment with its label facing out
tasks.name_ja: キャップを閉じたコンディショナーのボトルを、ラベルを手前に向けて洗面台の仕切りに立てる
instruction_variants: Put the conditioner bottle away in the organizer slot, standing up with the label facing out.
Stand the closed conditioner in its compartment on the vanity so you can read the label.
キャップを閉じたコンディショナーを洗面台の仕切りに立て、ラベルが手前に見えるように置いてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the closed bottle stands upright in its organizer compartment, label out. Labelled atomic: one object and one placement with an orientation, in one motion; upright and label_front are the pose of that placement. The bottle is supplied closed, so no cap action is part of the task. Contents are replaced with a water surrogate. Related Lane A task: task_reference_gso_round1_bottle_store_organizer also places an upright bathroom bottle in an organizer. This task is kept separate because its goal adds a label-forward orientation inside a named vanity compartment (label_front), which the Lane A task does not require; the two can be collected as variants of one placement family.

tasks.name_en: Hang both rinsed rubber gloves cuff-down over the sink caddy edge to drain
tasks.name_ja: すすいだゴム手袋を2枚とも、口を下にしてシンクのキャディの縁に掛けて水を切る
instruction_variants: Separate the wet gloves and hang each one over the caddy edge with the cuff pointing down so they drain into the sink.
Put the rubber gloves up to dry: fingers over the caddy rim, cuffs hanging down, not touching each other.
濡れたゴム手袋を1枚ずつ離し、口を下にしてシンクのキャディの縁に掛け、シンクに水が落ちるようにしてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: each glove hangs separately cuff-down over the caddy rim above the sink. Labelled compound: two gloves are separated and hung one after the other (two hanging predicates plus the separation), still in one sitting at one sink. Not atomic because it needs two grasp-and-hang sequences. The GSO scan is the pair as one rigid mesh; the gloves are rinsed with water only.

tasks.name_en: Wipe the marked scuff off the boat shoe toe, insert a shoe tree, and stand the shoe on the rack
tasks.name_ja: デッキシューズのつま先の印付きすり跡を拭き取り、シューツリーを入れて靴棚に立てる
instruction_variants: Wipe the scuff off the toe of the navy boat shoe, put the shoe tree in, and set the shoe on the rack.
Clean the marked scuff with the damp cloth, then tree the shoe and stand it up on the shoe rack.
紺のデッキシューズのつま先のすり跡を湿った布で拭き取り、シューツリーを入れてから靴棚に立ててください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the scuff is gone, the shoe tree is seated inside, and the shoe stands upright on the rack. Labelled compound: three goal predicates and three objects (shoe, cloth, shoe tree) in one sitting at one entryway; no reset or second destination, so not workflow. The scuff is a washable surrogate removed with a water-damp cloth. The GSO scan is rigid and does not model leather flex or tree insertion.

tasks.name_en: Unbox the facial cleanser, line it up on the vanity tray before the moisturiser and serum, and drop the carton in the waste basket
tasks.name_ja: 洗顔料を箱から出して、保湿液と美容液より前の順にトレイに並べ、箱をゴミ箱に捨てる
instruction_variants: Take the new cleanser out of its box, put it on the tray to the left of the moisturiser and serum, and throw the box in the bin.
Set the cleanser, moisturiser, and serum on the vanity tray in the order you use them, left to right, and bin the empty carton.
新しい洗顔料を箱から出し、トレイの保湿液と美容液の左に並べて、空き箱をゴミ箱に捨ててください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the unboxed cleanser stands closed on the tray in first position, the moisturiser and serum follow left to right, and the carton is in the waste basket. Labelled compound: four goal predicates and several objects in one sitting at one vanity; the bin is within reach, so there is no second destination stage. Connects to round 1: the disposal is gso_object_waste_basket, the Hefty basket modelled in gso_round1, staged beside the vanity. Contents are replaced with a water surrogate.

tasks.name_en: Take the two used kitchen towels to the laundry basket and hang two fresh towels from the pack on the oven handle and towel bar
tasks.name_ja: 使用済みのキッチンタオル2枚を洗濯かごに入れ、新しいパックの2枚をオーブンの取っ手とタオルバーに掛ける
instruction_variants: Pull the two used towels off the oven handle and towel bar, take them to the laundry basket, then open the new pack and hang one fresh towel in each spot.
Swap out the kitchen towels: dirty ones to the laundry basket, the new pair up on the oven handle and the bar, band in recycling.
オーブンの取っ手とタオルバーの使用済みタオルを洗濯かごに入れ、新しいパックを開けてそれぞれの場所に1枚ずつ掛け、帯はリサイクルに入れてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: both used towels are in the laundry basket, one fresh towel from the pack hangs on each of the oven handle and towel bar, and the band is in recycling. Labelled workflow: two stages with a checkpoint (both hanging points empty and used towels in the basket before the pack is opened) and several destinations, including a laundry basket outside the counter work zone. The oven is off and cool. The GSO scan is the banded pack as one rigid mesh.

tasks.name_en: Seat the lift-off lid squarely on the packed Monopoly Hotels game box
tasks.name_ja: 片付け済みのモノポリー・ホテルズの箱に、かぶせ式の蓋をまっすぐはめる
instruction_variants: Put the lid back on the Monopoly Hotels box so it sits flat all the way down on every side.
Close the game box: line the lid up with the base and press it down evenly.
モノポリー・ホテルズの箱に蓋をかぶせ、四辺とも奥までまっすぐはまるようにしてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the lid is seated on the box base on all four sides. Labelled atomic: one object (the box and its own lid) and one closure predicate in a single lift-align-lower motion. Packing the game contents is a precondition, not part of this task; stacking or shelving the box would be a separate task. The scan is one rigid closed box, so the lid is a declared part resource.

tasks.name_en: Close the powered-off handheld console fully on its hinge
tasks.name_ja: 電源を切った携帯ゲーム機を、ヒンジで最後まで閉じる
instruction_variants: Close the game console all the way so the two halves meet.
Fold the top screen of the handheld down until it is shut flat.
携帯ゲーム機の上画面を倒して、上下がぴったり合うまで閉じてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the console's two halves are shut on the hinge. Labelled atomic: one object and one articulation predicate (open to closed) in one rotation; the console stays where it lies. Putting it in a case or on a shelf is out of scope. The GSO scan is rigid and fixed in one pose, so the hinge must come from a physical console or a separately articulated asset.

tasks.name_en: Close the packed lunch box and snap its latch shut
tasks.name_ja: 詰め終えた弁当箱の蓋を閉めて、留め具をパチンと掛ける
instruction_variants: Shut the lunch box lid and click the latch closed.
Close the packed lunch box so the clasp is fully snapped.
詰め終わった弁当箱の蓋を閉め、留め具がカチッとはまるまで押してください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the lunch box lid is closed and held by its latch. Labelled atomic: one object and one closure predicate (latched_closed), done as one close-and-snap motion; the packed contents are a precondition. The scan does not model the hinge or latch.

tasks.name_en: Hang the gaffer tape roll by its core on the pegboard tape rod
tasks.name_ja: ガファーテープのロールを芯に通して、有孔ボードのテープ掛け棒に掛ける
instruction_variants: Slide the gaffer tape onto the tape rod on the pegboard.
Put the silver tape roll back on its pegboard rod through the cardboard core.
銀色のガファーテープの芯を有孔ボードのテープ掛け棒に通して掛けてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: the roll hangs on the rod through its core. Labelled atomic: one object and one placement predicate in one motion; the tabbed loose end is set up beforehand and preserved. The scan is a rigid roll and does not model adhesion.

tasks.name_en: Return 24 loose crayons to their box, tuck the flap, and drop the box in the red fabric cube
tasks.name_ja: ばらばらのクレヨン24本を箱に戻してふたを差し込み、赤い布製ボックスに入れる
instruction_variants: Put all the crayons back in their box tip-up, tuck the lid flap in, and put the box in the red fabric bin.
Refill the 24-crayon box, close it, and drop it into the red art cube.
クレヨンを24本すべて先を上にして箱に戻し、ふたを差し込んでから赤い布製ボックスに入れてください。
tasks.notes: Compound, not workflow: four goal predicates (all crayons inside, all tips up, flap tucked, box in bin) with two catalogued objects in one sitting and one destination. The 24 insertions repeat one skill loop rather than forming separate stages. Uses round-1 object gso_object_fabric_cube_red as the art bin. The GSO crayon-box scan is the packaged box only; the loose crayons are a planning resource.

tasks.name_en: Coil and tie the headset cable and hang the headset on the desk-edge hook
tasks.name_ja: ヘッドセットのケーブルを巻いて留め、机の縁のフックに掛ける
instruction_variants: Wind up the headset cable, strap it with the tie, and hang the headset on the hook by its headband.

Merges into data/drafts/gso_round2.json, which defines evidence_gso_task_design_round2.

Granularity: four atomic (pan on hook, mug on hook, jar lid screwed closed, can opener in drawer slot), three compound (plate stack with protectors, ramekin portions on tray, butter dish covered and refrigerated), one workflow (pet water bowl refresh).
Round-1 link: task_gso_r2_ramekins_portion_on_porcelain_tray binds the round-1 GSO porcelain tray (gso_object_porcelain_tray) as its tray; no round-1 record is redefined.

Resource IDs beginning gso_resource_ are planning object requirements (hooks, slots, protectors, matching plates and ramekins, surrogates, mats), not cataloged ObjectInstances or claims that matching assets exist.
